family.members: exact array unit_id:raw_id, partition all intelligible raw candidates
family.uncertain_with: local family IDs, no transitive merge

unit.raw: one row for every supplied raw opening
unit.post_only: rows per D ID containing an untraceable relation or unsupported certainty, [] allowed
unit.lineage_comment: covers every raw/D relation, rejection/parking and unsupported additions

raw.family_id: declared family or null only unintelligible

arm.raw: one row per exact raw source ID

normalization.agreed_scalars: Preserve exactly; every mismatch declared dispute
normalization.families: Compare co-membership not labels. Disputed connected clusters uncertain, never guessed
normalization.incomplete_review: Missing raw dual review gates raw findings. Missing/invalid D keeps raw dual coverage valid when available; post_assessment_complete false, retention unobservable with cause, retained/P10 gate.
normalization.adjudication: Scalar-only optional adjudication, declared mismatches only; agreed scalars exact; family clusters remain uncertain.
normalization.blind_order: Deterministic opaque IDs and counterbalanced order; retain all semantic evidence; recognizability remains possible
